name: Signature Saturday Ride (Seminole Cyclists)
schedule: Every Saturday, 7:30 am sharp from the Fresh Market lot. Speed groups from 18-20 mph (34 miles, 'BNice') up to 25+ mph (44 miles).

start_location.name: Fresh Market parking lot
start_location.address: 3775 Lake Emma Rd, Lake Mary, FL 32746

pace: BNice 18-20 mph for 34 miles; faster groups 21 to 25+ mph for 44 or 56 miles
visitor_notes: Seminole Cyclists is a membership club. Visitors can sign a waiver and ride three times as a non-member (the 'Waiver Only' option on the join page); after that you join to keep riding. A marshal checks the waiver at the start. Bring a helmet.
description: The Seminole Cyclists' signature ride, 51 Saturdays a year. It leaves Lake Mary, loops through rural Sanford past the airport and along Lake Monroe, and ends in Heathrow. Pace groups run from 18-20 mph to 25+ mph, with call-outs for the faster groups first and the slower ones last.
evidence: The club's calendar lists this ride for every Saturday through Dec 19, 2026 (session 40 of 51 is Oct 3), 7:30-10:30 am; the page is on the club's own site (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: One recurring event page lists every date in 2026. The marshal checks waivers at the start; the page says nothing about weather cancellations.

name: Festive Tuesday Night Ride (Seminole Cyclists)
schedule: Every Tuesday, 6:30 pm from Reiter Park. A recovery chat ride at 18-20 mph; the last 4 miles are a sprint back to the park.
visitor_notes: Seminole Cyclists is a membership club. Visitors can sign a waiver and ride three times as a non-member (the 'Waiver Only' option on the join page); after that you join to keep riding. A marshal checks the waiver at the start. Bring a helmet.
description: The club's recovery ride after the weekend's harder riding. It keeps an 18-20 mph pace with theme music and no focus on holding an exact speed. If there is interest, the group goes to PaPa B's or Alestone Brewing afterward.
evidence: The club's calendar lists this ride every Tuesday through Dec 22, 2026 (session 40 of 51 is Oct 6), 6:30-8:00 pm (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: One recurring event page lists every date in 2026.

name: Sunday Breakfast Ride (Seminole Cyclists)
schedule: Every Sunday, 8:00 am from Foxtail Coffee. 29 miles at a 20-21 mph effort.
visitor_notes: Seminole Cyclists is a membership club. Visitors can sign a waiver and ride three times as a non-member (the 'Waiver Only' option on the join page); after that you join to keep riding. A marshal checks the waiver at the start. Bring a helmet.
description: A 29-mile Sunday loop from Foxtail Coffee through Wayside, Markham Road and the Markham Woods area, back to Sanford. The club calls it fun and recovery at a 20-21 mph effort pace. Park at the shaded end of the lot.
evidence: The club's calendar lists this ride every Sunday through Dec 27, 2026 (session 40 of 52 is Oct 4), 8:00-10:30 am (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: One recurring event page lists every date in 2026.

name: Rescue Racing / Daily Beer Bar Ride
schedule: Every Wednesday, 6:00 pm from The Daily Beer Bar. Two pace groups, about 15-16 mph and 18+ mph; the calendar lists routes of about 20 and 26 miles.

start_location.name: The Daily Beer Bar
start_location.address: 108 E Main St Suite 101, Durham, NC 27701

visitor_notes: Road bike and kit are the norm (Bike Durham's guide says 'Gear: Kit; Bike: Road'). Check Rescue Racing's Instagram for the route and for rain cancellations.
description: A Wednesday evening road ride from downtown Durham with two pace groups. Bike Durham's ride guide lists it as no-drop and gives about 22 miles, in A and B groups. Route updates go out on Rescue Racing's Instagram.
evidence: The Bike the Triangle calendar (GoTriangle) lists the ride every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from The Daily Beer Bar, 108 E Main St, with dates through Dec 9, 2026; Bike Durham's ride calendar graphic is updated Sept 2026 (both fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The Bike the Triangle calendar is a WordPress Events Calendar; its ?ical=1 feed carries this ride's dates. The feed lists two entries per Wednesday (about 20 and about 26 miles).

name: Pony Ride
schedule: Second Tuesday of the month. Meet 6:30 pm at CCB Plaza, ride leaves at 7:00 pm and ends at Ponysaurus Brewing.

host.name: Ponysaurus Brewing Co. (listed by Bike Durham)

visitor_notes: Any bike works. The ride is the second Tuesday only. Check Ponysaurus's Instagram for rain cancellations.
description: A short, slow ride from downtown Durham that finishes at Ponysaurus Brewing. Bike Durham's ride guide lists it as about 8 miles at 8 to 10 mph, no-drop, casual gear, any bike.
evidence: The Bike the Triangle calendar (GoTriangle) lists Pony Ride on Oct 13, Nov 10 and Dec 8, 2026 (meet 6:30 pm, 'ride leaves at 7, ends at Ponysaurus'); Bike Durham's ride calendar graphic, updated Sept 2026, shows it on the second Tuesday (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The ?ical=1 feed on the Bike the Triangle calendar carries this ride's dates.

name: Scrappy Tuesday Durham Ride
schedule: Every Tuesday. Meet 7:00 pm, ride out at 7:30 pm. Road bikes on the first Tuesday, mountain or gravel on the third (Bike Durham's guide).
pace: About 13 mph; 12-15 miles (Bike Durham's March 2025 guide)
visitor_notes: The start point differs by source: the Bike the Triangle calendar says CCB Plaza ('meet at the Bull'), while Parts & Labor and Bike Durham's calendar graphic say Bullseye Bicycle (102 Morris St). Ask on Instagram (@parts8labor) if unsure. Rain or shine, per Parts & Labor.
description: A weekly Tuesday night ride out of downtown Durham, faster than the other cruiser rides. Parts & Labor says the ride is about two hours and finishes at Parts & Labor, where a $25 gift card is raffled each week. Different leaders take the first, third and fourth Tuesdays.
evidence: The Bike the Triangle calendar (GoTriangle) lists the ride every Tuesday through Dec 8, 2026, 7:00 pm meet and 7:30 pm roll; Bike Durham's ride calendar graphic, updated Sept 2026, lists 'Scrappy Tuesdays 7:30 PM' (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The ?ical=1 feed on the Bike the Triangle calendar carries this ride's dates. Parts & Labor's own series page repeats the ride to 2029, which is not proof.

name: Black Spoke Society Fourth Sunday Social Ride
schedule: Fourth Sunday of every month, 10:00 am to noon from CCB Plaza.
visitor_notes: Free. Water and snack stops when needed. Check the group's Instagram (@blackspokesociety) for updates; Bike Durham says some rides are seasonal or cancel in bad weather.
description: A no-drop, social-paced ride from downtown Durham led by Black Spoke Society. The organizer says you can be brand new to cycling and that no one gets left behind. Helmets required, lights encouraged. Bike Durham's ride guide lists the group as for Black and queer folks.
evidence: Downtown Durham Inc's event page lists the Fourth Sunday Social Rides for Oct 25, 2026, 10:00 am to 12:00 pm at CCB Plaza, organizer Black Spoke Society; Bike Durham's ride calendar graphic updated Sept 2026 shows it too (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: Downtown Durham Inc runs The Events Calendar; the event page carries the next date. Its sitewide ICS did not return this series when tried.

name: Bike Durham Community Ride
schedule: Fourth Monday of the month, 6:00 pm from Durty Bull Brewing.
visitor_notes: Any bike works. Bike Durham says to check the ride's social media (@bikedurham) for updates.
description: Bike Durham's own easy ride: about 8 miles at 8 to 10 mph, no-drop, casual clothes, any bike. It starts and ends at Durty Bull.
evidence: Bike Durham's own ride calendar graphic, 'Updated September 2026', lists 'Bike Durham Community 4th Monday 6PM'; the start and pace come from Bike Durham's March 2025 ride guide PDF (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: Bike Durham posts a ride-calendar image on its events page each month; re-read the image. The start point is from the March 2025 PDF.

name: Giro Ride (weekend Lakeshore Drive training ride)
schedule: Every Saturday and Sunday, about 7:00 am (an alternate 6:45 group). Riders gather from 6:30 at the Starbucks on Harrison Avenue. About 50 miles.
pace: Warm-up on Lakeshore Drive, then high 20s to low 30s mph on Hayne Blvd

host.name: New Orleans Bicycle Club (listed on its Rides page; informal group)

visitor_notes: The page says to contact the webmaster for updated information if you are new or visiting. Group size runs from about 10 in winter to about 50 in summer. Sprints at the end of Hayne and on the bridges. There is also an easier 'SaMoRi' group on Saturdays on the same route.
description: The standard big weekend training ride in New Orleans, year round. It warms up along Lakeshore Drive, then the pace rises into the high 20s mph past the Industrial Canal bridge, out Hayne Blvd to Venetian Isles and back. Saturdays run faster and bigger than Sundays. The club says it is not organized by any club or shop.
evidence: The New Orleans Bicycle Club's Rides page describes the Saturday and Sunday 7:00 am Giro and carries an 'As of September 2026' update on the levee rides (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: Page is hand-edited and carries dated notes; re-read it each month. Check the 'As of' dates.

name: Gretna Social Riders Friday Ride
schedule: Every Friday. Meet at the fountain next to Rivershack; roll at 7:00 pm.
visitor_notes: NOLA Social Ride says some groups on its metro list may no longer be active and to check each group's Facebook page. This one is on its current weekly list.
description: A weekly Friday evening social ride on the West Bank of the New Orleans area, listed on the NOLA Social Ride site's 'ride with us' list. The group posts details and route changes on Facebook.
evidence: The NOLA Social Ride site (copyright 2026, calendar listing rides through Oct 16, 2026) lists 'Every Friday: Gretna Social Riders, meet at the fountain next to Rivershack, roll at 7:00' (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The schedule is a line on the NOLA Social Ride list, undated. Rivershack's street address is not given; the group's Facebook page has the current details.

name: Sistahs on Wheels First Friday Ride
schedule: First Friday of the month. Rolls at 7:30 pm from City Park. All adults welcome.
visitor_notes: Details such as the meeting spot inside City Park are not on the list; check the group's Facebook page.
description: A monthly social ride out of City Park, listed on the NOLA Social Ride site's ride list. The listing says all adults are welcome.
evidence: The NOLA Social Ride site (copyright 2026, calendar listing rides through Oct 16, 2026) lists 'first Friday monthly: Sistahs on Wheels, rolls @ 7:30 from City Park, all adults welcome' (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The schedule is a line on the NOLA Social Ride list, undated. The group's own Facebook page was not found by a fetched link.

name: Wednesday Night Ride from Basil's (Boone Bike & Touring)
schedule: Wednesdays, typically 5:30 pm from Basil's Restaurant. Warm-weather months, around the time change in March and November.
season: Mid-March to October (around the time change)
visitor_notes: The shop says the route returns on Highway 321, which it does not recommend for solo riders, and that Parkway closures will force route edits throughout 2026. Boone Area Cyclists' page lists a Basil's ride on Tuesday at 5:30 and a Wednesday ride from Magic Cycles, so confirm the day before you go.
description: The shop's official Wednesday night route starts at Basil's near the Boone Mall and runs to Blowing Rock via the Blue Ridge Parkway, about 25 miles with 2,200 feet of climbing. It averages 18-20 mph with competitive segments, and the shop calls it a no-drop ride with regroups at key points.
evidence: Boone Bike & Touring's Local Rides page describes the Wednesday Night Ride from Basil's at 5:30 pm and says Blue Ridge Parkway closures will force route edits 'throughout 2026' (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: Page says the rides run in the warmer months, around the time change; confirm in late October and again in March.

name: Tuesday Night Ride and Grill (CAMP)
schedule: Tuesdays, 5:30 pm CST at Chewacla State Park. Trek Auburn's October list shows Oct 6, 13, 20 and 27.
visitor_notes: The shop's list does not say the pace or the surface. CAMP is a mountain bike association and Chewacla is a trail park, so expect trail riding and bring lights as the days shorten. CAMP's own site blocks automated reads; check it or Trek Auburn before you go.
description: CAMP's weekly Tuesday evening ride and cookout at Chewacla State Park in Auburn. Trek Bicycle Auburn lists it on its events calendar month by month.
evidence: Trek Bicycle Auburn's events page lists 'Tuesday Night Ride and Grill (CAMP), Chewacla State Park, 5:30 p.m. CST' for Oct 6, 13, 20 and 27, 2026 (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: Trek Auburn posts a month-by-month list; a new month's list appears near the start of the month.

name: Shenandoah Shuffle (Baton Rouge Bike Club)
schedule: Every Tuesday, 5:30 pm from Capitol Cyclery. No-drop C pace, routes of 5, 10 and 20 miles.

start_location.name: Capitol Cyclery
start_location.address: 5542 Jones Creek Rd, Baton Rouge, LA 70817

pace: C pace, 10-15 mph, no faster than the slowest rider
cost: first ride free; non-members limited to two rides
visitor_notes: Baton Rouge Bike Club rides are for members, but the first ride is free and non-members are limited to two club rides (its 'About A Club Ride' page). Helmets required, sign-in with a contact phone. Bad-weather cancellations go on the club's Facebook group.
description: A weekly Tuesday evening ride through the residential streets of Shenandoah, Lake at White Oak and White Oak Landing. The club calls it a no-drop ride at a C pace (10 to 15 mph, no faster than the slowest rider) for experienced and new riders. The leader picks a 5, 10 or 20 mile route in advance.
evidence: The club's Ride with GPS event list shows the 2026 Shenandoah Shuffle at 5:30 pm from Capitol Cyclery on Oct 6, 13, 20 and 27, 2026 (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: The club's Ride with GPS organization lists each Tuesday as its own event; the club's Google Calendar embed also carries them (2026 Shenandoah Shuffle, through Oct 27). Start time moves with daylight saving; check after Nov 1.

name: Tour du Café C Ride (Baton Rouge Bike Club)
schedule: Sundays, 11:30 am from the Broadmoor United Methodist Church parking lot (11:45 am from the Goodwood Library lot on some board-meeting Sundays). Riders join at Goodwood Park at noon and City Park Tennis Center at 12:30.

start_location.name: Broadmoor United Methodist Church parking lot

pace: C pace, 10-15 mph, no faster than the slowest rider
cost: first ride free; non-members limited to two rides
visitor_notes: Baton Rouge Bike Club rides are for members, but the first ride is free and non-members are limited to two club rides (its 'About A Club Ride' page). Helmets required, sign-in with a contact phone. Bad-weather cancellations go on the club's Facebook group. The start moves to the Goodwood Library lot on some Sundays, so read the week's event listing.
description: The club's Sunday no-drop ride at a C pace (10 to 15 mph). It starts with a 40 mile ride from Broadmoor, picks up riders at Goodwood Park (30 miles total) and at the City Park Tennis Center (20 miles total), and stops for coffee. The leader says less experienced riders can learn group skills on it.
evidence: The club's Ride with GPS event list shows Tour du Cafe C Ride on Sundays through Sept 27, 2026 at 11:30 am (Aug 16 marked cancelled); no October Sundays were posted yet (fetched Oct 2, 2026).

refresh.notes: Each Sunday is its own Ride with GPS event, posted a week or two ahead; if no October dates appear, the ride may be paused.
